artifact_policy: Candidate masks, all search/holdout scalar metrics, teacher-cache metadata, frozen decisions, and compact full-test evidence are included. Dataset text, token IDs, teacher probability caches, and model weights are not redistributed.

adaptations: MCQA prompt/gold-answer calibration replaces the original paper's corpus
256 unique evaluations and TAPE layer bounds replace the original search budget/space
an independent train-holdout stage replaces direct search-set winner selection
initial random allocations use exact uniform feasible-count sampling
method.bounds: same per-layer bounds and exact global budget as TAPE
method.fitness: full-vocabulary overlap; mean answer positions then questions
method.ranking: the unchanged REAP rankings used by the released TAPE reference
method.search: 32 initial + 8 generations of 28 unique offspring; 4 elites
method.selection: maximum independent train-holdout ESAP, mask SHA-256 breaks ties
method.shortlist: 24 highest search-ESAP candidates, replacing last with uniform if absent
method.variant: REAP ranking + full-vocabulary ESAP, budget-matched adaptation
